en.name: Pollock
en.summary: Pollock is the workhorse white fish behind fish fingers and surimi crab sticks: mild, soft-flaked, very lean and landed in enormous quantity. Almost all of it is frozen at sea within hours of the catch. Fresh fillets keep 1–2 days in the fridge from purchase, and 4–8 months in the freezer.
en.pantry: Fresh pollock has no room-temperature allowance, and it loses condition faster than a firmer white fish because the flakes are soft and full of water — an hour in a warm kitchen leaves a fillet visibly slack. The 2-hour rule applies, or 1 hour above 32 °C (90 °F). Ask at the counter whether the fillet was previously frozen, because with pollock it usually was, and a thawed fillet cannot be refrozen raw.
en.fridge: 1–2 days from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in a single layer, never stacked, on the coldest shelf and below everything ready to eat. Keep it out of its own drip: pollock takes up water more readily than a dense-fleshed fish, and a fillet sitting in liquid turns to mush. A rack inside a covered box, with ice under the rack, holds it nearer to freezing point than a fridge shelf manages alone — tip the melt water out each time you check on it. Judge freshness by springiness: press a fillet and it should come back.
en.freezer: 4–8 months at −18 °C (0 °F), and with pollock it is texture that runs out first rather than flavour; badly wrapped, it comes back dry and cottony. Wrap airtight with no air pocket anywhere, or glaze it with a dipped layer of ice, and freeze in flat meal-sized portions. One honest observation: pollock frozen at sea within hours of the catch is usually better than anything a domestic freezer can do to a fillet that has already spent two days travelling, so buying it frozen is no compromise. At −18 °C it stays safe indefinitely.
en.thawing: In the fridge overnight on a plate, or sealed in a bag under cold running water. Never on the counter, never in warm water. Pat it thoroughly dry — pollock holds a lot of water and a wet fillet steams instead of browning — cook it at once, and do not refreeze it raw.
spoilage: A sour or ammoniacal smell instead of a clean, mild one.
Flesh that stays dented when pressed rather than springing back.
Flakes that gape apart, or a milky film on the fillet.
A grey or yellow cast where the flesh should be white.
tips: Ask whether it was previously frozen; if so, cook it rather than refreezing.
Keep it on a rack over ice, never in melt water.
Ice-glaze before freezing — thin soft fillets burn quickly.
Buy frozen-at-sea pollock without hesitation; it is often the better fish.

faq.q: How long does pollock keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 1–2 days from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, on ice and not sitting in water.
Yes, 4–8 months at −18 °C, wrapped airtight or ice-glazed. Do not refreeze a fillet that was sold thawed.

faq.q: Is pollock the fish in fish fingers and surimi?
faq.a: Usually, yes. Alaska pollock is the main species used for both, which is why it is one of the most-caught fish in the world.

faq.q: How can you tell if pollock has gone off?
faq.a: A sour or ammoniacal smell, a milky film, gaping flakes, or flesh that will not spring back when pressed.

zh.name: 狹鱈
zh.summary: 狹鱈是白肉魚裡的主力：味道溫和、肉片鬆軟、極低脂，漁獲量非常大，也是魚柳條和蟹味棒的原料。它幾乎全部都在捕獲後幾小時內於船上急速冷凍。生鮮魚片從購買日起冷藏可放 1～2 天，冷凍 4～8 個月。
zh.pantry: 生鮮狹鱈沒有室溫的額度，而且它掉狀況的速度比質地緊實的白肉魚更快，因為肉片鬆軟又含水多——在溫暖的廚房裡放一小時，魚片就明顯癱了。適用 2 小時原則，氣溫超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。買的時候問一下這片是不是解凍品——狹鱈通常都是，而解凍過的魚片不能生的再冷凍回去。
zh.fridge: 從購買日起放 4 °C 以下 1～2 天，單層平放、絕對不要疊，放最冷的層架、位置低於所有即食食品。別讓它泡在自己滲出的水裡：狹鱈比肉質緊密的魚更會吸水，一片泡在液體裡的魚片會直接爛成糊。有蓋的盒子裡放網架、網架下鋪冰，能把溫度壓得比單靠冰箱層架更接近冰點——每次看它的時候順手把融水倒掉。判斷新鮮度就按一下：好的魚片會彈回來。
zh.freezer: 在 −18 °C 下 4～8 個月，而狹鱈先用完的是口感而不是風味；包得不好，解凍後就是又乾又像棉絮。請包到完全不留空氣，或浸冷水做一層冰衣，再按一餐的量壓平分裝。有一件事值得老實說：在船上、捕獲後幾小時內急速冷凍的狹鱈，通常比你家冷凍庫能對一片已經旅行了兩天的魚做的任何事都好，所以買冷凍品一點都不吃虧。在 −18 °C 下安全性可以無限期維持。
zh.thawing: 放盤子上冷藏隔夜解凍，或密封裝袋以冷水沖。不要放檯面，也不要泡溫水。下鍋前徹底擦乾——狹鱈含水多，濕的魚片下鍋只會冒蒸氣而不會上色——擦乾就立刻煮，生魚不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或有氨味，而不是乾淨溫和的魚味。
按壓後凹陷回不來，而不是有彈性。
肌肉纖維裂開，或魚片表面出現乳白薄膜。
本該白皙的魚肉泛灰或泛黃。
tips: 問清楚是不是解凍品；是的話就煮掉，不要再冷凍。
架在網架上放冰的上方，不要泡融水。
冷凍前做冰鍍——又薄又軟的魚片很快凍燒。
放心買船凍狹鱈，品質常常更好。

faq.a: 鋪冰、不泡水，放 4 °C 以下，從購買日起 1～2 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 4～8 個月，密封包好或做冰鍍。解凍品不要再冷凍。

faq.q: 魚柳條和蟹味棒用的是狹鱈嗎？
faq.a: 通常是。阿拉斯加狹鱈是這兩者的主要原料，也因此成為全球捕獲量最大的魚種之一。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷狹鱈不新鮮了？
faq.a: 發酸或氨味、表面乳白薄膜、肌肉纖維裂開，或按壓沒有彈性。
